The best avocado & kale smoothie near the Pinked Church
Aug 2026 • Friends
I stumbled on this local smoothie store while visiting the Pinker Church in HCMC. The store design is a traditional Vietnamese style with a modern twist. They have many fresh fruit smoothies and tea with no added sugar nor condensed milk. The signature drink is the Avocado with kale smoothie with a surprise popping oatmeal. It’s really great to hear the agricultural story from the founder and it’s one of the hidden germ if you are around the Tan Dinh District 1 area. Highly recommended

Must try!!!
Aug 2026 • Friends
Perfect stop after visiting the Pink Church

I was exploring the city center and visiting the Pink Church when I found this place literally a minute away, so I stopped in to cool down. I tried the strawberry banana smoothie, really refreshing, with a nice sweet and sour taste. The strawberry jelly was such a good addition and somehow reminded me of strawberry milk. The staff explained that their smoothies are made with local Vietnamese fruits and little to no added sugar, which was nice to know. Service was great and the atmosphere was very relaxing, especially upstairs where you get a beautiful view of the Pink Church. A really nice find.

Avocado lovers should try this place
Aug 2026 • Friends
If you like avocado smoothies and tropical Vietnamese fruit, this place is definitely worth trying. I ordered their bestselling avocado smoothie and it was thick, creamy and tasted really good. My friend had the avocado strawberry, which was a little fruitier. We ended up sharing both. Before leaving, I also picked up a cute Vietnamese hat keychain as a memory from the trip. Friendly staff, fresh drinks, and definitely worth a stop if you’re in the Tan Dinh area or exploring the city center.

Best Vietnamese smoothie near Pinked Church
Aug 2026 • Friends
When I was visiting the Pinked Church, I stumbled upon this store while they have a "smoothie party." I spoke with the manager and learned a very interesting story about this local brand. Apparently, the architecture is inspired from Vietnamese heritage with the conical hat, the straw wall designed, and they have beautiful upstairs area for pictures. They try to promote local Vietnamese fruit and healthy lifestyle which is so cool. It wasn't much a wait when I came and the staff can speak English.
